_note: Where every file comes from, and which collection it lands in. 04_push_local_to_blob_cosmosdb.py fetches start into blob/data_db/ingestion/raw/<collection>/ and later onto the shelf, later/; 07_push_new_files_from local_to_blob_cosmosdb.py moves the shelf into the mirror. Each is uploaded to ingestion/raw/<collection>/<name>, and the function reads the collection from that first folder. A url is downloaded; a path is copied from this machine. Neither the files nor their content are in git: the TD reports are TD's, and the media came from a course.

start.name: td-annual-report-2025.pdf
start.what: a long report with charts in it: page citations, figures, tables, and the vision model on real pictures

start.name: office.png
start.what: a photograph: Document Intelligence reads whatever words are in it

start.name: example.png
start.what: a second picture, to see whether two behave the same

start.name: male.wav
start.what: speech: Azure Speech transcribes it, and it is cited by the minute

start.name: toddler.mp4
start.what: a video: ffmpeg takes the sound out, then Speech. Only the sound is read, never the picture

later.name: video.mp4
later.what: the trigger test: dropped after the first batch is indexed, to watch the function wake by itself

later.name: td-consolidated-financial-statements-2025.pdf
later.what: a second build, and a section of the annual report, so near-duplicate text is exercised too
